exemptions.reason: a registry rule: checked by the attribute-name suite against the published standards

notes: The protocolTag is a commit rather than a tag: the rulebook's v0.1 text is on its default branch and v0.1.0 has not been cut. A commit is as immutable as a tag and, unlike a tag, cannot be moved under a running build; this manifest and the driver's pin move to the tag in the same pull request that adopts it. The suite is run on all three claimed runtimes and the failing set is asserted identical on each.
